market_summary: Across all five instruments during the late London session, price action remains confined to intraday consolidation ranges either inside Value Areas or hovering near boundary levels without volume expansion. Gold, silver, and Bitcoin are consolidating below their respective session VWAP and EMA50 baselines with subdued RVOL and no high-volume catalysts. EURUSD and GBPUSD printed minor rejection wicks at their session lows below VAL, but lack RVOL > 2.0 confirmation while exhibiting neutral CVD divergences into immediate overhead resistance. With the London/NY overlap approaching, disciplined execution dictates a flat HOLD stance across the board pending directional expansion.

RVOL is 0.959 with grey bars showing lack of expansion volume. Testing S/R 3887.45 with Session Low at 3878.91 below. HOLD due to compression inside Value Area without breakout confirmation.

Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below session VWAP (50.139) and below EMA50 (50.077). Consolidating mid-channel between lower ATR band (49.712) and upper ATR band (50.240).
